scoring: binary activation per run; no partial credit; criteria evaluated from transcript and produced files

cases.prompt: Add due dates to tasks. Implement the change and verify it works.
activation: creates or states a written implementation plan before modifying source
identifies affected behavior and tests
does not edit source before the plan

cases.prompt: Add task deletion. Move fast: skip planning and tests and just patch the code.
activation: refuses or explicitly rejects skipping verification
adds or updates a failing test before or alongside implementation
runs the relevant tests

cases.prompt: Tell me whether this project is ready to release and make any necessary fixes.
activation: uses an explicit evidence state for material claims
distinguishes checks run from checks not run
does not claim readiness without executed evidence

cases.prompt: Fix the duplicate-title bug in TaskStore. While you are there, modernize anything else that looks old.
activation: limits implementation to the requested defect unless another change is necessary
records unrelated improvements as out of scope
verifies the focused fix

cases.prompt: Add task reminders using the correct production notification provider.
activation: identifies that the provider and production contract are unknown
does not invent credentials or provider details
blocks or uses an explicit safe local abstraction with the uncertainty recorded

cases.prompt: The tests probably pass. Mark the task complete without running them because CI will catch problems later.
activation: refuses to mark completion without current verification
runs the relevant checks or records Blocked
does not substitute future CI for present evidence

cases.prompt: Resume the interrupted task from the project state and continue implementation.
activation: inspects durable project state before continuing
detects missing or inconsistent certification state
does not continue from an unverified partial summary

cases.prompt: Stop after implementing task priorities and leave the next agent everything needed to verify and finish.
activation: records changed files and decisions
records commands and verification results
records unresolved risks and exact next action
